description_en: Creates an alias for a customer master key (CMK)
description_zh: 为主密钥（CMK）创建一个别名
name: CreateAlias

parameters.help_en: The globally unique identifier of the CMK
parameters.name: key_id

parameters.help_en: The alias of the CMK. The alias must be 1 to 255 characters in length, must contain the `alias/` prefix, and cannot start with the reserved word `alias/acs`
parameters.help_zh:
CMK的别名名称。  
长度为1~255个字符，必须包含前缀`alias/`，但不能以`alias/acs`保留字为前缀
parameters.name: alias_name

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
